About.title: About
About.p1: Hi! My name is <github>Nata Repkina</github>, and this project was created as part of the React course at RS School.
About.p2: This app is a small Star Wars search project powered by the <swapi>SWAPI API</swapi>. You can search for characters, planets, starships, and other information from the Star Wars universe.
About.pMe1: I’m a bit of a designer, a bit of an SEO specialist, a bit of a juggler — but mostly a frontend developer. I enjoy building interfaces, learning how applications work under the hood, and turning ideas into interactive web projects.
About.pMe2: While working on this app, I practiced React, component-based architecture, routing, API requests, and state management.
About.pCourse: This project is part of the RS School React training program, where I’m improving my frontend skills through hands-on practice and real-world-style tasks.
